_provenance: Hand-authored demo fixture. The book titles and authors are real; the connections between them are a designed graph structure, not observed behaviour. This is NOT scraped from Amazon or Goodreads and must not be presented as real 'customers also bought' or 'readers also enjoyed' data. It exists so the pipeline is runnable and testable without a multi-gigabyte download. For real data see the ingest commands in README.md.
